summary: Completed full e2e testing of Chhaon Cafe Ops MVP — backend (24 pytest tests) and frontend (auth, orders kanban, new-order flow, kitchen, menu CRUD, dashboard, supply, users, role-gating, mobile bottom-nav, logout). All flows pass. No critical issues.

issues: On the Orders board screen, the desktop top-nav appeared to only render Orders/Reports/Team in one rendering; on /orders/new the same top-nav showed Orders/New/Kitchen/Supply/Menu/Reports/Team. Likely the Orders board hides the 'New' nav item because the page already has a big 'New order' CTA; not a bug but worth confirming. Bottom-nav on 390px viewport is correctly visible and sticky.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 730+ lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into auth.py / menu.py / orders.py / supply.py routers for future maintainability.
All endpoints correctly exclude Mongo _id via _menu_out/_order_out/_supply_out helpers — clean.
JWT_SECRET, CORS_ORIGINS, ADMIN_MOBILE/PASSWORD all sourced from env. Admin seed is idempotent (updates password if env changes) — matches playbook.
Bcrypt hash format ($2b$) used. Login uses mobile+password (not email) per PRD; tokens stored in localStorage 'chhaon_token' as documented.
No brute-force lockout implemented (5 fails -> lock). Not required by PRD but mentioned in playbook_testing_instructions. Optional hardening for future.
